\tikzset{
  rnndiagram/.style={
    font=\small,
    line cap=round,
    line join=round,
    >=Latex
  },
  rnninput/.style={
    circle,
    draw=blue!65!black,
    fill=blue!8,
    line width=0.5pt,
    minimum size=8mm,
    inner sep=0pt,
    align=center
  },
  rnnstate/.style={
    circle,
    draw=black!70,
    fill=white,
    line width=0.5pt,
    minimum size=9mm,
    inner sep=0pt,
    align=center
  },
  rnngate/.style={
    circle,
    draw=orange!80!black,
    fill=orange!10,
    line width=0.5pt,
    minimum size=7mm,
    inner sep=0pt,
    align=center
  },
  rnnoutput/.style={
    circle,
    draw=green!55!black,
    fill=green!8,
    line width=0.5pt,
    minimum size=8mm,
    inner sep=0pt,
    align=center
  },
  rnnblock/.style={
    draw=black!18,
    fill=black!3,
    rounded corners=2pt,
    align=center,
    inner sep=6pt,
    outer sep=1pt
  },
  rnnarrow/.style={
    -Latex,
    semithick
  },
  rnnrecur/.style={
    -Latex,
    semithick,
    bend left=32
  },
  rnnskip/.style={
    -Latex,
    semithick,
    dashed
  }
}

\newcommand{\RNNInputNode}[3][]{\node[rnninput,#1] (#2) {#3};}
\newcommand{\RNNStateNode}[3][]{\node[rnnstate,#1] (#2) {#3};}
\newcommand{\RNNGateNode}[3][]{\node[rnngate,#1] (#2) {#3};}
\newcommand{\RNNOutputNode}[3][]{\node[rnnoutput,#1] (#2) {#3};}
\newcommand{\RNNBlockNode}[3][]{\node[rnnblock,#1] (#2) {#3};}

% END_SHARED_PREAMBLE

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[rnndiagram, x=1cm, y=1cm]
  \node[rnninput] (x) at (1.0,1.2) {\(x_t\)};
  \node[rnnstate] (hprev) at (1.0,-1.2) {\(h_{t-1}\)};
  \node[rnnblock, minimum width=3.7cm, minimum height=1.3cm] (cell) at (4.2,0) {\shortstack{RNN 单元\\\(\phi(W_x x_t + W_h h_{t-1} + b)\)}};
  \node[rnnstate] (h) at (7.6,0) {\(h_t\)};
  \node[rnnstate, dashed] (hnext) at (7.6,1.9) {\(h_{t+1}\)};
  \node[rnnoutput] (y) at (7.6,-1.9) {\(\hat{y}_t\)};

  \draw[rnnarrow] (x.east) -- (cell.north west);
  \draw[rnnarrow] (hprev.east) -- (cell.south west);
  \draw[rnnarrow] (cell.east) -- (h.west);
  \draw[rnnarrow] (h.south) -- (y.north);
  \draw[rnnskip] (h.north) -- node[right] {传到下一步} (hnext.south);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
